prompt: In the soft glow of an anime style village market at dawn, a woman in a blue apron stands on the left side of the frame holding a woven basket. Next to her, a gray cat sits calmly on a wooden crate, its tail wrapped neatly around its paws. The woman looks at the cat with a gentle expression while handing a small fish to it. In the center, an old man in a straw hat leans against a stack of clay pots, his eyes closed in quiet contemplation. Beside him, a young boy in green overalls points excitedly at a bright red apple held by a merchant in a white tunic. The merchant smiles warmly as he hands the apple to the boy, creating a moment of simple joy. To the right, a blacksmith in a leather apron wipes sweat from his brow with a rag, standing next to a glowing forge that emits faint sparks. A brown dog lies near the blacksmith’s feet, chewing on a bone with evident satisfaction. Behind them, a girl in a yellow dress runs past a stall draped with colorful fabrics, her hair flowing behind her. She looks at a hanging lantern that sways gently in the morning breeze. Near the lantern, an elderly woman in a purple shawl sits on a low stool, knitting a long scarf. A pigeon perches on her shoulder, cooing softly as she works. In the background, a farmer in muddy boots carries a sack of grain on his shoulder, walking toward the edge of the market. He passes a cart pulled by a tired ox, which stands still with its head lowered. A child in a striped shirt climbs onto the cart’s wheel, balancing carefully while looking at the ox. The scene is bustling yet peaceful, capturing the quiet energy of early morning trade. There is no modern technology visible in this rustic setting. There is no rain or storm clouds overhead, only clear skies.
